description: This file contains functions for retrieving and processing MAC addresses from various sources such as device tree, JSON configuration, MTD partitions, MMC, and UCI configs. It also includes utility functions for MAC address manipulation and detection of device tree status.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address label from device tree or JSON configuration.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition name.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from an MTD partition using a key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted MAC address from an MTD partition using decryption utilities.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted MAC address from an MTD partition with specific decryption key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config stored in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address in text form from an MTD partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC part of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string with separator.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administration' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string into canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled (okay).
